title: LP-NAS: Linear Programming-based Neural Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.14472v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) aims to automate neural network architecture design, reducing reliance on human expertise. Among the various NAS methods, differentiable NAS has gained prominence due to its efficiency and accuracy compared to conventional NAS approaches. Since differentiable NAS relaxes the architecture search space into a continuous domain, it is possible to apply principles from continuous optimization to NAS. In this paper, we propose Linear Programming-based NAS (LP-NAS), a mathematical programming-based framework for differentiable NAS that is applicable to a wide range of continuous search spaces. LP-NAS formulates a linear program (LP) using the validation-loss gradient and the training-loss Hessian to compute an architecture update direction that improves generalization while preserving the optimality of the model parameters. translated_title: LP-NAS：基于线性规划的神经架构搜索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14472v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：神经架构搜索（NAS）旨在自动化神经网络架构设计，减少对人类专业知识的依赖。在各种NAS方法中，可微NAS因其相较于传统NAS方法的效率和准确性而受到重视。由于可微NAS将架构搜索空间松弛到连续域，因此可以将连续优化的原理应用于NAS。在本文中，我们提出了基于线性规划的NAS（LP-NAS），这是一种基于数学规划的可微NAS框架，适用于广泛的连续搜索空间。LP-NAS利用验证损失梯度和训练损失Hessian矩阵构建一个线性规划（LP），以计算一个架构更新方向，该方向在保持模型参数最优性的同时提高泛化能力。通过遵循这个由LP导出的下降方向，LP-NAS高效地导航架构空间。
tldr: 提出了一种基于线性规划的神经架构搜索框架，利用验证损失梯度和训练损失Hessian构建LP来计算架构更新方向，在保持参数最优性的同时提升泛化能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a linear programming-based neural architecture search framework that constructs an LP using validation-loss gradient and training-loss Hessian to compute architecture update directions, improving generalization while maintaining parameter optimality.
